title: Bar Drop Banana Ice 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Banana Ice delivers a rich and intensely satisfying tropical fruit profile with a deeply refreshing finish. The inhale is characterised by the sweet, creamy taste of ripe Banana, providing a smooth and authentic fruit foundation. This is immediately followed by a crisp, cooling layer of Ice on the exhale, perfectly balancing the sweetness for a clean and refreshing vape. The double-concentrated flavour formulation ensures that the banana and ice notes remain exceptionally vivid with every draw. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
